name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a calm, knowing smile, eyes gentle and patient.
components.effects: Loose leaves and faint {{MAGIC}} motes of pollen drift and swirl gently around her, stirred by living magic. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Sylvanya, visible in the distance beyond the trees, an Elder Dragon of emerald-green and forest-sage scales, trailing drifting leaves and spores, wings like broad canopy leaves veined in moss-gold

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
